Players Committee card image of [[Crusher Roodown]] (original printing), game text: “Power -3 with Unkar Plutt. Once per battle, may use 1 Force to peek at cards stacked on Graveyard Of Giants; place one in owner's Lost Pile to add one destiny to total power at same or adjacent site. May take your starship just drawn for destiny into hand.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual4-Light/large/crusherroodown.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
